title: Code-world edit: a left lane change ahead of the ego
subtitle: Lyft Level 5, Palo Alto, daytime · 25 s, 126 keyframes at 5 Hz, canvas at 12 Hz · single agent session (Claude Opus 5.5)
task: Edit the scenario in code: the car ahead of the ego changes one lane to the left and continues straight.

steps.label: Plan
steps.text:
Edit one vehicle of a recorded Lyft Level 5 scene in its code world: a car ahead of the ego, travelling in the same direction, changes one lane to the left on a multi-lane road.
Requirements: a smooth lateral move over about 4 s; drivable road and same-direction lanes only; no new conflict with any agent or with the ego; keyframe 0 unchanged; the car in view and well within 40 m during the manoeuvre, inside the 185 frames the video model sees.
Procedure: screen the candidate scenes, analyse the chosen car and its neighbours, edit a copy of `scene_world.py`, verify it with `sanity.py` before rendering and with the checks of `make_case.py` after rendering.
kv: 16 Lyft scenes, 126 keyframes each (5 Hz, 25 s)
static world, ego path, camera, keyframe 0

steps.label: Screen the candidate scenes
steps.code:
# SAW: a left lane change needs a car ahead of the ego
#      with a same-direction lane free on its left

# 1. list the vehicles of each scene: frames, speed,
#    visibility in the model window, start position
$ sanity.py --scene <scene> --list        # 16 scenes

# 2. shift every car 8-35 m ahead by +3.4 m; test the
#    drivable area, road dividers, +-14 m clearance
$ scan_lc.py <16 scenes>
#    -> 2 cars keep the left lane clear for > 25 kf

steps.label: Two candidates
steps.text:
**A**: car 1e81 drives 20-28 m ahead in the ego lane of a daytime boulevard with a signalised intersection; the lane to its left carries traffic in the same direction.
**B**: car f292 is already in the left lane, 21-43 m ahead, and later moves to the right on its own.
A is selected: the car is closer, centred in the view, and a lane change frees the ego lane.

media.label: real front camera, keyframes 0 / 25 / 50 (top: A, bottom: B)

kv: clear for 55 kf from kf 4; blocked by 3d8d at kf 60
clear for 75 kf from kf 10; 31 m ahead
at most 12 kf of clear left lane

steps.label: Recorded motion of the car and its neighbours
steps.code:
# SAW: scene A, car 1e81 21 m ahead in the ego lane

# 1. follow 1e81 and every vehicle within +-35 m of it
$ neighbors.py <scene A> 1e811fdf 90 4
#    -> kf 0-48: 4.3-8.8 m/s, 20-28 m ahead of the ego
#    -> kf 52-91: slows to 2-5 m/s and turns right
#    -> left lane: truck 3d8d beside the ego, 25 m back

# 2. draw the recorded paths on the drivable map
$ scene_bev.py <scene A> ... --kmax 90 --hl 1e81

steps.label: The car turns right at x = 110 m
steps.text:
1e81 brakes from keyframe 48 and turns right into a side road at x = 110 m. After a left lane change this turn would have to cross the ego lane, so the edited car has to continue straight.
The left lane is free ahead of 1e81; the 7.3 m truck 3d8d drives beside the ego, about 25 m behind 1e81.

media.label: recorded paths, world frame of keyframe 0 (hatched: crosswalks, dashed: lane lines)

kv: 4.3 m/s at kf 0, 8.8 m/s at kf 26-44, then braking

steps.label: First edit: lane change, then straight on (v1)
steps.code:
# SAW: the right turn cannot follow a left lane change;
#      the car continues straight in the new lane
car = scene.agent('1e811fdf...')

# 1. path: recorded route to x = 80 m, then straight on
car.reroute([(21.424, -0.001, 1.142), ...,
             (229.4, -1.95, 0.9)])

# 2. cruise instead of braking; extend to keyframe 125
car.set_speed(8.8, from_t=44)
car.span(0, 125)

# 3. one lane (3.4 m) to the left over 4 s
car.lane_change(3.4, t0=14, t1=34)
$ sanity.py --scene <scene A> --edited scene_world_v1.py
#    -> WARNING overlaps another agent in 64 frames

steps.label: Check: the truck runs into the car
steps.text: The lane change itself is clear. Afterwards the truck 3d8d accelerates to 12.9 m/s behind the 8.8 m/s car and overlaps it from 12 Hz frame 184 (keyframe 76) on; the ego later passes it at 1.25 m. The speed after the lane change has to match the faster left lane.

media.label: position along the road over time, v1

steps.label: Speed of the left lane (v2)
steps.code:
# SAW: neighbors.py on 3d8d and 08a4: 3d8d reaches
#      12.9 m/s by kf 56; 08a4 enters the left lane at
#      x = 148 m at kf 70 and drives at 16.6-17 m/s

# 1. same path; headings follow it (old ones turn right)
car.reroute([...])
car.headings = None
car.span(0, 125)

# 2. recorded motion to kf 30, then 1.45 m/s^2 to 16.5
s, v = car._s(30), car.speed(30)
car.timing = {t: x for t, x in car.timing.items()
              if t <= 30}
for t in range(31, 126):
    v = min(v + 1.45 / 5, 16.5)
    s += v / 5
    car.timing[t] = s
car.lane_change(3.4, t0=14, t1=34)
#    -> sanity: no warnings

steps.label: Check: clear of all agents
steps.text: The car now stays ahead of 3d8d and about 34 m ahead of 08a4 once 08a4 appears. The nearest agents are in adjacent lanes. No lane_divider crossing is reported.

media.label: position along the road over time, v2

steps.label: Render v2 and inspect the BEV
steps.code:
# SAW: sanity is clean; render both worlds

# 1. delta-patch the boxes, render the 12 Hz canvases,
#    model-input crops and BEVs, then run the checks
$ make_case.py --scene <scene A> --case lc_left \
      --edited scene_world.py --wait
#    -> CHECK OK; edit visible from frame 34

steps.label: Check: the lane change lies in the intersection
steps.text: Frame 0 is bit-identical and the edit is visible from frame 34. The BEV shows, however, that the lateral move (frames 34-84) takes place inside the signalised intersection, between the two crosswalks, where the map has no lane lines; this is also why no lane_divider crossing was reported. A lane change inside the intersection is not the most plausible manoeuvre.

media.label: v2, edited BEV at frames 34 / 60 / 84 (magenta: edited car)

kv: 159 frames, 151 in the model window, first 34
lane lines end at x = 44 m, resume at x = 77 m; crosswalks x = 40-79 m

steps.label: Lane change before the intersection (v3)
steps.code:
# SAW: the dashed lane line ends at x = 44 m; in kf
#      1-21 the car covers x = 22-47 m at 4.3-8 m/s

# 1. start right after keyframe 0, same 4 s duration
car.lane_change(3.4, t0=1, t1=21)
$ sanity.py --scene <scene A> --edited scene_world_v3.py
#    -> no warnings; lane_divider crossed at frame 26

# 2. render again under the same case name
$ make_case.py ... --case lc_left --wait
#    -> CHECK OK; visible in 182 of 185 model frames

steps.label: Check: sanity of the final edit
steps.text: The car crosses the dashed line at x = 33 m and reaches the centre of the left lane at the first crosswalk. Peak lateral speed is 1.3 m/s; the heading departs at most 12 degrees from the lane, at 6 m/s. The nearest agents are in adjacent lanes, and the ego stays at least 16 m behind.
